items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview, 1967-06-01
items.q: Mr. Golda lived back. They're too quiet for me.

ctx.x: How far back towards the lake did you get? Never did. Always along Chippewa Street.

Mr. Golda lived back. They're too quiet for me. I like it. They got a ball in the corner and they hear all the music and the jazz every night. I don't know why I never went. I walked to the center and hear the music.
Did you ever live on Magazine Street? Constance?
